items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: I feel that I owe this to a friend of mine, because we started out as musicians together... Valmo and I were classmates.

ctx.x: Yeah, probably maybe Decatur then. Most likely. Several people told us they played there.

Oh yeah, and this is something else that I'd like to go in the interview. I feel that I owe this to a friend of mine, because we started out as musicians together. And to be perfectly frank, the first organized group that I played in was in the high school orchestra. And Professor Valmo Victor, he's a retired school teacher now. He's still around now. He's still here in New Orleans. And it would be nice if you wouldn't interview him. Yeah, it would be nice if I could interview him. What is the whole name again now?
